# The call budget is 5. The planner and the four agents of section 1 (two readers, the judge and the writer) use it up. The reader of the first source of section 2
# does not run: its claims run, two levels below the question run, waits for a person.
# The person adds 2 calls. The two readers of section 2 run, and the judge in the question run waits. The run is cancelled, as an upgrade would strand it,
# and the item runs again with a larger cap. The new run keeps the plan and the finished section 1, so the planner and the agents of section 1 do not run twice.
# Section 2 starts again from its source runs, so its readers run again.
[!exec:jq] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

rdinit
rdfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env RESEARCH_DESK_DIR=$WORK/rd
env RESEARCH_HOME=$WORK/store
env SEARCH_API=http://search.test
env WIKI_API=http://wiki.test
env RESEARCH_HEADER_FILE=$WORK/home/.research/credential.header
env MAX_AGENT_CALLS=5

exec beehestreal item add research-desk cold-cost --title 'Cold and cost' --body-file body.txt
! exec beehestreal run cold-cost research-desk --workflow rd/workflow.star &

waitstatus 'paused: The run used all 5 agent calls'
grep -count=1 '^5$' store/cold-cost/calls
grep 'done' store/cold-cost/s1.1/status
! exists wiki.log

# The answer goes to the claims run of the first source of section 2, whose id is the seventh run of the desk: research-desk-7.
# The runs before it are two source runs and two claims runs for section 1, then the first source run of section 2.
exec beehestreal answer research-desk-7 2
waitstatus 'paused: The run used all 7 agent calls'
grep -count=1 '^7$' store/cold-cost/calls
exec beehestreal cancel cold-cost
wait

env MAX_AGENT_CALLS=40
exec beehestreal run cold-cost research-desk --workflow rd/workflow.star &
waitstatus 'paused: Review the draft report of cold-cost, round 1'
exec beehestreal answer cold-cost approve
wait
stdout 'item cold-cost finished'

# The planner ran once and section 1 ran once. Section 2 ran again from its start, because it was not done.
cmp calls.log expected-calls.log
grep -count=1 '^cold-cost-' wiki.log

-- body.txt --
How does the cold change the output of a unit, and what does it cost?
-- expected-calls.log --
plan
read cold
read cold
judge
write Output
read cost
read cost
read cost
read cost
judge
write Cost
abstract
-- home/.research/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- resp/_search --
{"results":[{"url":"http://pages.test/page/a"},{"url":"http://pages.test/page/b"}]}
-- resp/_page_a --
<p>Winter tests. At -20 C the output fell by 30 percent.</p>
-- resp/_page_b --
<p>The unit costs 12 euro per month.</p>
